executiveSummary: Actively exploited NetScaler ADC/Gateway vulnerabilities (incl. CVE-2026-88779) continue to provide adversaries with edge-device footholds; patch immediately and assess for compromise. Security Advisory CISA KEV F5 BIG-IP APM (OAuth Authorization Server) heap overflow (CVE-2026-94127) is under exploitation; hotfixes and interim iRule are available. Security Advisory Red Lion Controls N-Tron 700 Series industrial switches contain critical unauthenticated management and DoS flaws; upgrade to 3.11.1+ and disable/lock down management services. ICS Advisory Advantech EKI-1242EIMS/IEIMS gateways expose unauthenticated command execution and critical-function bypass; isolate, block TCP/5058, and apply vendor updates when available. CISA Bulletin State-linked Chinese operations targeting critical infrastructure continue (Integrity Technology Group and allied campaigns), combining botnets, VPN abuse, and LOTL techniques; ingest IOCs and harden remote access. Joint Advisory Fortinet FortiMail path traversal (CVE-2026-104286) added to CISA KEV; patch rapidly and review for pre-patch compromise. CISA KEV Active scanning/exploitation attempts observed for Atlassian CVE-2026-21589; patch affected products and add WAF rules for "..::" traversal. View Article

topThreats.title: 3) Red Lion N-Tron 700 Series ICS Switch Flaws

items: China-linked campaigns leveraging automated scanning, VPN infrastructure, credential spraying, and LOTL techniques against multiple CI sectors; email exfiltration and persistence observed. Joint Advisory Supporting Report
Russia-aligned UAC-0099 evolving MATCHBOIL downloader targeting transportation, manufacturing, and energy in Ukraine; potential IT footholds adjacent to OT. View Article
Criminal mass exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft (CVE-2026-35273) for data theft with WAF-bypass techniques; risk of credential harvesting at CI-adjacent orgs. View Article Supporting Report
Ransomware operators abusing Active Directory GPO to cause domain-wide disruption at a manufacturing firm without deploy­ing Windows encryptors (encryptionless extortion). View Article

relevance: Current risk is elevated for operators relying on internet-facing remote-access gateways and legacy ICS network components. Active exploitation against NetScaler and BIG-IP APM provides a direct path into enterprise identity stores and jump hosts, from which adversaries can pivot toward OT enclaves. Simultaneously, critical flaws in ICS switches and protocol gateways (Red Lion N-Tron, Advantech EKI-1242) can undermine segmentation and device integrity if reachable. The convergence of edge exploitation, identity weaknesses, and unmanaged OT assets increases the likelihood of disruptive outcomes without strong network separation, monitoring, and rapid patching.

descriptions: Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190): NetScaler, BIG-IP APM, Atlassian, Metabase, FortiMail
Valid Accounts (T1078) and Credential Access (T1003/T1556): AD/Entra ID abuse, DCSync, ADCS ESC1
Command and Scripting Interpreter (T1059), WMI (T1047), Scheduled Task/Job (T1053) for persistence/movement
Exfiltration Over Web Services (T1567.002): EWS/API data theft; email exfil
Living off the Land (LOTL): PowerShell, PsExec, native admin tools; identity token abuse
Network Service Discovery (T1046) against telemetry/OT protocol services (STTP/DDS/OPC UA)

outlook72h: Continued NetScaler/BIG-IP APM exploitation attempts against lagging patch populations; expect webshell/persistence discovery post-patching. Proof-of-concept and opportunistic scanning likely to expand for Atlassian traversal and Metabase SQLi; watch for API brute-force and credential stuffing. OT edge devices with weak/unauth services (Red Lion, Advantech gateways) may see targeted probing; prioritize segmentation and allowlists. Increased phishing and token abuse tied to state-linked email collection; monitor OAuth app consents and anomalous mailbox access.
